commands.1: 1: Select 4K MIND. Explore programs within a 4 KiB memory budget.
commands.2: 2: Select 1976 MULTIVERSE. Check partial CPU/RAM designs against reviewed historical sources.
commands.3: 3: Select SELFHOST/1. Begin with raw machine code; later construction stages need separate evidence.
commands.4: 4: Select 256-BYTE UNIVERSE. Test deposited 256-byte candidates against an output/return task.
commands.5: 5: Select RAM REPUBLIC. Observe participants interacting through shared memory.
commands.MODELS: MODELS: List the available model records.
commands.MODEL: MODEL model-id: Verify and select a local model. Example: MODEL qwen-coder
commands.START: START: Launch one bounded run of the selected experiment and model. Takes no arguments. Use STATUS to follow it.
commands.STATUS: STATUS: Show the selected model, worker state, runs and resource readings.
commands.RUNS: RUNS: List recorded runs and their state. Completion alone does not establish scientific success.
commands.SHOW: SHOW run-id: Read the family evaluation and checkpoint. Copy a run ID from RUNS.
commands.TRANSCRIPT: TRANSCRIPT run-id [page]: Show model/Monitor exchanges. Without a page, show the latest 12 per cell; page 0 starts at the beginning.
commands.STOP: STOP run-id: Request cancellation of that run. Its saved state is retained.
commands.RESUME: RESUME run-id: Continue a saved run using its recorded model registry.
commands.EXPORT: EXPORT run-id: Create a verified evidence bundle on the configured SSD.
commands.OPEN: OPEN bundle-path: Verify and inspect an exported bundle on the configured SSD. Quote paths containing spaces.
commands.META: META [LIST|QUEUE] or META CLAIM|HISTORY claim-id: Browse recorded claims, evidence and review work.
commands.SELFHOST: SELFHOST [LIST] or SELFHOST INGEST run-id | REBUILD artifact-id | QUALIFY evidence-path | EXPORT artifact-id | OPEN bundle-path: Inspect or work with the persistent virtual construction archive.
commands.LESSONS: LESSONS: List the available Field Library lesson folders.
commands.SOURCE: SOURCE lesson: Read a lesson and its sources without calling a model. Example: SOURCE S01. The older SOURCE lesson sources form also works.
commands.ASK: ASK lesson question: Ask a source-grounded question. Example: ASK S01 What is an Apple-1?
commands.HINT: HINT lesson question: Ask for a hint grounded in the lesson.
commands.EXPLAIN: EXPLAIN lesson question: Ask for an explanation grounded in the lesson.
commands.CHECK: CHECK lesson question: Check your work using the lesson and its answer material.
commands.TRACE: TRACE lesson "assembly with \n separators": Execute assembly in the virtual harness, then request an explanation.
commands.HELP: HELP [command]: Show the command list or help for one command. Example: HELP START
commands.QUIT: QUIT: Close the console. Active runs continue in their user service; STOP run-id requests cancellation.
